name: Push
description: Web Push for every app on this server. Each app gets its own VAPID keys from its CI with NOOK_TOKEN; browsers subscribe and get a handle anyone can notify, now or at a set time. Built for local-first apps with no backend of their own.

env.desc: A mailto: address push services can reach you at, like mailto:you@example.com
Pushes one handle can get an hour, sent and scheduled together
